summary: Round r1 (restricted network). Imported shares of consumption and origins for fuel, fertiliser, rice and medicines are all pending. The method (apparent-consumption ratio in physical units, supplier HHI, origin vs route distinction, FY vs calendar-year separation) is specified. Leads reused from 16A and extended: Department of Customs annual trade statistics book FY2079/80 and Nepal Trade Portal (product-by-origin tables), UN Comtrade mirror data, NOC import/sales and publications, FAOSTAT food balance and fertiliser data, DDA, NRB major-imports table, World Bank Pink Sheet and NLSS-IV. Latest customs books after FY2079/80, MoALD production statistics and the G2G fertiliser agreement text were not located; these are data gaps.

findings.claim: Imported share of consumption for petroleum products (petrol, diesel, kerosene, ATF, LPG), by product, and origin of imports.
findings.note: Requires `python -m src.cli leads --fetch` for the listed lead URLs, extraction of the named tables and ingest as observations in r2. Petroleum: domestic production is nil for refined products, so consumption equals NOC sales plus stock change; origin from NOC supply arrangement and customs HS 27 by partner.

findings.claim: Imported share of chemical fertiliser use (urea, DAP, MoP) and origin (India, China, others; G2G vs tender).
findings.note: Requires `python -m src.cli leads --fetch` for the listed lead URLs, extraction of the named tables and ingest as observations in r2. Customs HS 31 by partner (product tonnes) vs FAOSTAT nutrient use; informal cross-border inflows unrecorded.
findings.period: Nepal FY / calendar year - keep separate

findings.claim: Imported share of rice consumption (HS 1006 rice and paddy) and origin, and exposure to Indian export restrictions on rice.
findings.note: Requires `python -m src.cli leads --fetch` for the listed lead URLs, extraction of the named tables and ingest as observations in r2. Paddy-to-milled-rice conversion factor must be documented; MoALD production statistics needed as denominator (lead not yet located).

findings.claim: Imported share of medicine consumption (finished formulations, HS 30) and origin; origin of active pharmaceutical ingredients (HS 2941 and HS 29 chapters) used by domestic manufacturers.
findings.note: Requires `python -m src.cli leads --fetch` for the listed lead URLs, extraction of the named tables and ingest as observations in r2. DDA domestic vs imported market share; customs HS 30 and API lines by partner.

findings.claim: Supplier concentration (HHI) by product across origin countries.
findings.note: Computed from customs partner data once retrieved.

findings.claim: Import dependence = imports / (domestic production + imports - exports +/- stock change), computed in physical units where possible (tonnes, kilolitres), with value-based shares reported separately; formal customs data understate imports where informal border trade is material (rice, fertiliser).
Country of origin (customs) is distinct from route of supply; India-route dependence for non-Indian-origin goods is taken from 21B, not inferred from origin data.
Mirror data (partner-reported exports to Nepal, calendar year) are kept as a separate value from Nepal customs imports (Nepal FY); differences are investigated, not averaged.

data_gaps: Customs annual trade statistics books for FY2080/81 and FY2081/82 not located as files.
MoALD Statistical Information on Nepalese Agriculture (rice production, fertiliser distribution) not located.
Primary text of the India-Nepal G2G fertiliser supply arrangement not located (news pointer only).
NOC-IOC supply agreement text and product-level annual report not yet located as files.
DDA annual report with domestic vs imported market share not located as a file.
The session web-search budget was exhausted part-way through r1; further leads for this task must be located in r2 or by the orchestrator.

assumptions.text: Import dependence = imports / (domestic production + imports - exports +/- stock change), computed in physical units where possible (tonnes, kilolitres), with value-based shares reported separately; formal customs data understate imports where informal border trade is material (rice, fertiliser).
Country of origin (customs) is distinct from route of supply; India-route dependence for non-Indian-origin goods is taken from 21B, not inferred from origin data.
Mirror data (partner-reported exports to Nepal, calendar year) are kept as a separate value from Nepal customs imports (Nepal FY); differences are investigated, not averaged.

challenges.text: Agree with proposed EXP-P01 (food staples) and EXP-P09 (API origin). Also note that petroleum (EXP-05) should record a supplier-concentration metric distinct from import share, since import share is structurally complete for refined products.

channels.py lacks an 'essential_supplies' channel owned by 21D; fertiliser and medicine dependence are currently mapped to agricultural_output and transit_and_logistics respectively. Suggest reconciling; 21D does not edit platform code.
Rice import-dependence needs MoALD production data as the denominator; request that 07A share the production series it uses so the same vintage is applied.

uncertainty: High. No values retrieved. Import shares are sensitive to informal trade, stock changes, unit conversions and FY/calendar-year mismatches; medicine dependence understated if API origin is ignored.

essential_import_dependence.formula: imported_share = imports / apparent_consumption; apparent_consumption = production + imports - exports - stock_change

products.product: petroleum products (petrol, diesel, kerosene, ATF, LPG)

products.denominator_source: MoALD production statistics (lead pending); FAOSTAT food balance

essential_import_dependence.period_basis: Nepal FY for customs, NOC, DDA; calendar year for FAOSTAT and Comtrade mirror data - separate columns, no mixing without documented conversion
known_issues: informal cross-border trade in rice and fertiliser
product tonnes vs nutrient tonnes for fertiliser
domestic medicine production depends on imported APIs
